# arXiv

> > arXiv is an open-access repository of electronic preprints for scholarly articles in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, electrical engineering, systems science, and economics.

Founded in 1991, arXiv hosts over 2 million research papers and serves as a critical resource for researchers worldwide to share and access cutting-edge scientific work before formal peer review. The platform is maintained by Cornell University and supported by the Simons Foundation.

## Key Topics

- arXiv preprint repository
- Open-access scholarly articles
- Mathematics research (General Mathematics, math.GM)
- Preprint submissions and archives
- Subject category organization
- Mixed Tate Motives
- Mandelbrot Set
- Lucas Sequences
- Hurwitz zeta function
- Goncharov-Brown theory
- Mathematical research database
- Academic preprint distribution
- Cornell University repository
